title: A scattered soul does not become whole by accident.
summary: One-pointedness is named directly because divided attention rarely matures into peace.
takeaway: Wholeness usually begins by narrowing what the heart obeys.
lifeApplication: Give one practice your full mind today, even if only for a few minutes.

source.shortMeaning: One-pointed Naam, saint company, and steady remembrance belong to the same path.
source.lifeApplication: Make focus an act of love, not mere discipline.

evidence.coreClaim: One-pointed Naam, saint company, and steady remembrance belong to the same path.
evidence.turn: Soft speech becomes believable when the ego has begun to bow.
evidence.practicalImplication: Give one practice your full mind today, even if only for a few minutes.
